text:
Maya (CS): FYI — drop-in playbook for the first 14 days after go-live: focused on account health signals, warmup, batching, and a short escalation matrix.
Sam (SRE): love it. can you add metric thresholds? e.g., p95 token latency > 750ms triggers warmup scale.
Maya (CS): yep. included below — this is intended to be customer-facing and short. use it in handoffs.
Jordan (AM): quick q — do we recommend proactive prefix prefetch for chat-heavy flows?
Maya (CS): yes, recommend prefix prefetch + small KV cache for session tokens. suggest prefill size ~20 messages for first 5 sessions.
Lee (Support): adding a tidy email + steps for CS to nudge customers if renew risk appears.
Maya (CS): snippet: 
```
# warmup curl loop (example)
for i in {1..10}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"gpt-xl-8k","input":"warmup: hello","max_tokens":1}' &
  sleep 0.4
done
```
Sam (SRE): nice. also a short metric config suggestion: p95_latency_ms: 750, error_rate_pct: 1.0, queue_depth: 50
Maya (CS): escalation matrix: 
- Alert if p95 > 750ms for 5m AND errors > 0.5% -> CS owner to message customer + ops runbook
- If p95 > 1500ms or errors > 2% -> open a priority ticket with Dedicated oncall
Jordan (AM): and renewal flags? how do we capture that signal
Maya (CS): Renewal risk tags: low usage after day 7, rising error rate, repeated warmup failures. Capture in CRM and trigger a 1:1 with AM.
Lee (Support): Added a one-click play link in the console for prefill warmup now.
ops-bot: [automation] prefill job queued for customer: acme-inc — 10 warmup requests
Maya (CS): final note — share feedback with #cs-feedback and include the conversation id. Keep this playbook under 2 screens for customer docs.
Jordan (AM): will share with ACME tomorrow, thanks.
